notes.goal: Reach the upper doorway through a sequence of three usable gate shields, retaining the last shield for a second pushing direction.
notes.change: Create a new folded passage with eastbound delivery, a southbound handoff, westbound delivery and a northbound reuse of the final shield.
notes.reason: Each landing must deliver the player to an executable next input. The last landing needs clear ground for changing the final shield's pushing side. Earlier shields may stay parked after their verified handoff.
expectedChecks: Independent freezes of all three shields

notes.change: Trim unused north/east/south parking space, make the upper doorway unambiguous, and bind observed handoffs to the design contract.
notes.reason: The first ordinary replay completed in 37 inputs. Its broad landings admit unnecessary parking states. The revision preserves working stances while removing unused alcoves, then tests whether leaving the last shield off the northbound lane prevents the next input.
expectedChecks: Compare two reachable states with the same player approach
